scope: Two additional playable forms: billiards / breakout. Existing visual editions, modules, assets and normal saves are preserved.

cue.title: 暮色台球
implemented: Authored walnut, brass and green felt tabletop
Six-ball practice and fifteen-ball triangular rack
First-contact aim preview and object-ball direction
Power slider, mouse/drag aiming and keyboard controls
Ball-to-ball momentum collision, rail restitution, rolling friction, six pockets and cue-ball respot
Independent saves and actual clear-table completion
browser_verified: Potted count changes to 1/6 with one stroke
Dedicated fullscreen exit and full-width aligned control strip
limitations: Free clear-table practice, not a standard eight-ball opponent match
Cue spin / English is not simulated
Full clear-table end card was not manually reached in the browser

prism.title: 琉璃星阵
implemented: Authored celestial observatory, glass bricks and mechanical paddle
Two layouts, with double-layer bricks in the second act
Actual ball travel and collision; paddle contact location changes return angle
Three lives, surviving brick progress and score
Falling expansion capsules and 18-second enlarged paddle
Easy and standard widths, pointer/drag/keyboard and HTML touch controls
browser_verified: First launched ball breaks one brick and scores 115
Move paddle to catch the ball, then hit again: 2 bricks and 230 score
Refresh restores 34 surviving bricks and 230 score
A miss consumes a life and retains the surviving layout
Dedicated fullscreen exit and full-width aligned control strip
prism.ending_capture_status: Manually lost all three balls: 10 bricks cleared, 1465 score, 0 lives; ending card inspected and refresh retained the completed failure state.

normal_save_handling: All reset, mode-switch, motion and completion QA used qa=1 save keys. The original mini-golf/train-dispatch user tab was not reset or navigated. The new normal-save comparison is ready to start.
